newsitem.title: CHINA: Standard Chartered Bank to open Pudong branch.
newsitem.headline: Standard Chartered Bank to open Pudong branch.

text.p: Britain's Standard Chartered Bank will officially open its branch in Shanghai's Pudong development zone next Monday, a bank official said on Wednesday.

Standard Chartered is one of nine foreign banks granted a licence by China's central bank to conduct local currency business on the condition that it move its main Shanghai branch to Pudong, across the Huangpu River from the city centre.
The bank moved from the western part of Shanghai to its new premises in Pudong at the end of June, and had already started yuan currency business, the official said.
A ceremony would be held on Monday to mark the formal opening, she said, adding that group chief executive Malcolm Williamson and Chinese officials planned to attend.
